understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete every level by moving each selectable piece onto a goal tile marked +; when multiple goals existed, all had to be occupied simultaneously for the level to report WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces moved one grid cell per directional action, while walls could block movement and pushable blocks could be shifted when adjacent. The selected piece was controlled by MOVE actions, and CLICK switched control to another selectable using its pixel/grid position. Movement-blocked hints were only heuristic, so actions sometimes needed to be tested.
